measuretitle: Feeling things done in life are worthwhile
title: The percentage of UK [(adults)adults] reporting low levels of feeling things done in life are worthwhile has remained stable since 2018
sourcetext: Annual Population Survey from the Office for National Statistics
commstext: Of UK adults, 4.0% rated how worthwhile they feel the things they do in life are as low in July to September 2023. This shows no short-term change (4.2% in July to September 2022) or long-term change (3.5% in July to September 2018).
